info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fraud Diagnosis API
info.description: The Fraud Diagnosis API is designed to provide insights and assessments regarding potential fraud in banking account activities. By leveraging advanced analytics, it allows financial institutions to identify and diagnose fraudulent behavior effectively. This API serves as a vital resource for risk management teams and fraud analysts, enabling them to access detailed information on specific accounts through the unique parameter provided. Typical use cases include real-time fraud detection, post-incident analysis, and regulatory compliance monitoring.

get.summary: Retrieve Fraud Diagnosis for a Specific Account
get.description: This endpoint allows the retrieval of detailed fraud diagnosis information for a specific account identified by its unique resource ID. Utilize this to assess and understand the fraud status of the account.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a fraud diagnosis for a particular account. It requires specific parameters to effectively assess potential fraud issues associated with the account identified by RES-100045.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the fraud diagnosis data.

GetFraudDiagnosisForAccountRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the fraud diagnosis endpoint of the account management service.
